method: Each regular expression is tested independently on the named fields; category is an additional filter. Groups may overlap. No code, installed behavior, dependency compatibility or intellectual provenance was compared.
interpretation: Keyword-selected purpose neighborhoods, not exact functional duplicates or a functional duplication rate. Missing keywords do not imply unique purpose; matched descriptions can refer to one feature inside a larger product.

examples.name: dsh-aqua-theme
